name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.82.1 — spec-queue add refuses unknown --flags (exit 2, nothing written) instead of folding them into the payload; a spec path plus a stray --root once landed as a free-text prompt item. 7.82.0 — look stops are now decided on the served atlas page instead of a terminal question: `lib/mocks-picks.js` is the sole reader/writer of `design/mocks/picks.json` (candidate groups, one group per flow); `design-atlas.js` exports `buildAtlas`, `page`, `frameTag`, `createRequestHandler` and runs its CLI dispatch only under `require.main`, with new `GET /__picks/list` and `POST /__picks/decide` routes; an open or decided stop renders in place, in the section its screens already live in, as a compare table (one row per step, one column per candidate) with a one-click Pick this / Approve / Change, re-pickable until the mocks driver consumes it; the server stamps a `notes-scope` meta tag on every page it serves so the notes layer shows exactly one scope per page and hides its bar while the lightbox is open. 7.81.0 — atlas viewport buttons now rewrite each card's W×H label along with the frame (it was stamped once at load and stayed at the first viewport after switching). Direct patch, no spec — JJ 2026-09-05 at the Hearwell SHAPES look stop. tests/design-atlas.test.js. 7.80.0 — `worktree-include.sh` (`spec-paths worktree-include`) is now the sole owner of copying a host's `.worktreeinclude`-matched gitignored files into a new worktree: `merge-back.sh create` calls it in place of its inline copy block, and `/spec:replay`'s `--setup` now calls it too, before the setup gate runs, so a scratch worktree on a host that boots from env files no longer dies at setup or smoke for a reason unrelated to the reviewer being measured; a host with no manifest is unchanged. `spec-paths` gains the `worktree-include` key.
